svg.title: Signal readout - who I am in five numbers
svg.desc: Five radial HUD gauges: 10+ years across the full software development life cycle; 50+ microservices on an event-driven AWS platform he helped build and support; PyTest coverage kept above 85% on all new code; +20% performance from a 3,000 to 1,000 line OOP refactor; 5 domains: finance, healthcare, retail, pharma and insurance.
